title: Granite Query
subtitle: Learning More from Less
research_question: Can student aware data selection help Granite learn mathematical reasoning from DeepSeek more efficiently than random selection?
next_action: Implement and locally validate the bounded Granite LoRA training smoke test.
caveat: Teacher pilot uses training questions. It is not held-out accuracy or evidence of Granite improvement.

events.title: Teacher API pilot completed
events.detail: All 16 seeded GSM8K training questions received DeepSeek responses. Fifteen passed the strict verifier. No test questions or Granite training were used.

events.title: Correct answer rejected for currency formatting
events.detail: One solution ended with a dollar sign before 13. The strict numeric parser rejected it; this is a formatting rejection, not evidence of incorrect arithmetic. Original output retained.

events.title: Sandbox network failure resolved
events.detail: The first connectivity attempt failed to resolve the provider hostname. The authorized network-enabled retry verified both services and completed the pilot.

events.title: Scheduled supervision enabled
events.detail: A recurring check is configured every 15 minutes, with durable local state and approximately hourly active progress reports. Local checks require the computer and app to remain running.

events.title: Public research journal and Pages preview
events.detail: Preparing an append-only activity history, generated journal, and public dashboard. Publication will be verified before being reported as live.
